I build data pipelines and turn messy data into decisions people can act on.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone [This project uses machine learning to predict housing cost using property and location features.\]](capstone.qmd) for
state officals and state housing authorities.

I care about housing, finance, sport analytics, reproducible workflows, and explaining a model to the person
who has to trust it.

**Currently looking for** Data analyst and Data scientist  roles
starting 09/2026. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
